description: CENTRAL CANONIZATION REGISTRY. This is the single place David declares what canon IS (equation forms, law dictionary, variable meanings, grammar). Edit 'statement' + 'patterns' here; fis_canon_scan.py disperses these rules into every folder's .fisnote CANONIZATION section and red-flags text that contradicts them. Scans NEVER modify content files - they only report. Each ruling carries its own version + status (binding/draft/retired); scan reports cite ruling versions so old reports stay intelligible after canon changes. A third scan verdict NEEDS_CANON_DECISION marks text the registry does not yet rule on.

rulings.title: Godel incompleteness - correct statement
rulings.statement: Godel's second incompleteness theorem: any CONSISTENT, effectively axiomatized formal system that interprets enough arithmetic cannot prove its own consistency. Self-reference is NOT the criterion ('powerful enough to reference itself' is a misstatement). Godel gives unprovability-from-within; he does NOT by himself establish an external ground - use the regress argument for that.
rulings.source_ruling: Reviewer correction to THE-JUDGMENT-LAYER-CANONICAL_1.md Section X, 2026-08-04

rulings.title: Noether's theorem - correct statement
rulings.statement: Noether's (first) theorem: every DIFFERENTIABLE symmetry of the ACTION of a physical system with conservative forces corresponds to a conservation law. It applies to continuous symmetries of the action - not 'every symmetry gives a conservation law' unqualified, and not discrete symmetries.
